headline: US Stock Futures Edge Higher Following Tech Rout as Fed and Earnings Loom
summary: U.S. stock futures edged slightly higher following sharp losses in the technology sector, with investors focusing on upcoming Federal Reserve policy developments and corporate earnings reports.
why: Major equity index futures signal market opening trends and broader investor risk appetite ahead of critical macroeconomic and earnings events.

impacts.name: S&P 500 Futures
impacts.why: Futures rebounded modestly following tech declines ahead of corporate earnings and central bank news.

why_moved: Futures edged up as markets consolidated after steep tech-led drops, awaiting key earnings and Fed guidance.
